name: Shar Vahl
description: Shar Vahl is the proud Vah Shir capital city on Luclin, rebuilt and expanded after the Terror of Luclin era. The city blends tribal heritage with civic guilds, arcane infrastructure, defensive watchposts, and cultural districts. It serves as the homeland of the Vah Shir and the primary safe haven near Shadeweaver’s Thicket.
